parsed.rationale: The structural evidence shows a Jaccard similarity of null and shared_field_count of 0, meaning the two protocols share no common members. `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` (line 20, HLSPlayer module) exposes HLS/AVPlayer-specific members such as `seekableTimeRanges:[NSValue]`, `seek:(to time: CMTime) async -> Bool`, and `rate:Float`, while `AudioEnginePlayerProtocol` (line 34, MP3Streamer module) exposes audio-engine-specific members such as `installRenderTap:()`, `scheduleBuffer:(_ buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer)`, and `eventStream:AsyncStream<AudioPlayerEvent>`. The only superficial overlap is the presence of a `pause:()` and `play:()` verb in both, but their signatures differ (`play:()` vs `play:() throws`) and the surrounding contracts are entirely distinct — one is an HLS video/audio stream player backed by AVPlayer, the other is a low-level PCM audio engine. Introducing a shared parent protocol would create a false abstraction coupling two unrelated playback subsystems within the same `Playback` package.
